title: Proot Distro X11 1.2.1
release_notes:
• Desktop installation removed: run any command on its own display
• Microphone is off at start; the toolbar button is the only switch
• Presets refresh on their own, with a refresh button in the sheet and on the Display tab
• Each container's sheet shows only its own presets; detected apps get a no-sandbox checkbox
• Share works without a tunnel: the URL opens a sign-in page for the access code
• The keyboard opens through the noVNC panel; fullscreen hides the status and navigation bars
• Guest app notifications are forwarded as Android notifications (best effort)
• Arch pacman works under proot
• Ads between Distros and Presets, every five presets, and after the Home install list
• Terminal default theme follows the app mode: Dracula in dark, Colab Light in light
• Play device support restored (microphone, touchscreen, leanback not required)
